title: Golden Yellow Modern Retractable Wall Hook - 2-1/2 Inch Pull-Out Hanging Space, Wall Mount Brass, Holds 15 Lb, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Golden Yellow,

Keep towels and robes within reach without cluttering your walls—this modern retractable wall hook pulls out when you need it and pushes back in when you don’t, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it’s a space-saving solution for crisp, clean modern bathroom hardware.

  • Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Match your existing look: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with a cabinet knob of your choice
  • Designed for everyday use: brass construction for enduring performance
  • Easy, straightforward install: mounts to standard interior walls with included toggle bolts and hardware

Specifications

  • Product type: Retractable wall hook
  • Hanging space (pull-out): 2-1/2 in
  • Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 2 x 2 x 3.75 in
  • Projection: 1 in
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount (toggle bolts; screw size 6/32 toggles)
  • Wall requirements: Fits standard interior walls; requires drilling a 3/4 in diameter hole through drywall and 3 small holes around
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Lifetime warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces to build a coordinated, contemporary bath accessories look.
meta_description: Modern retractable wall hook with 2-1/2 inch pull-out hanging space. Wall-mounted brass design holds 15 lb and retracts flush when not in use.

The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2'' of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
